answer: I found two articles in effect today that still tell customers to use a retired form. "Selling a family member's car for them" says to have form NW-POA-1 signed in front of a notary. NW-POA-2 replaced NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and an NW-POA-1 signed before that date was only accepted until June 30, 2026. "Broken or replaced odometer" says to mark 'not actual mileage' on form NW-ODO-1, but NW-ODO-2 replaced NW-ODO-1 on February 1, 2026. Other articles I checked name forms with no replacement listed (NW-NMC-1, NW-LRL-1, NW-BUS-1, NW-EST-1, NW-MIL-1, NW-DMG-1, NW-PLT-1). The search returns only 5 articles at a time, so I can't be sure I found every article.
